alternating5.derivation: closure of two even permutations of degree 5 under composition; the count is checked against the n=5 entry of /classification/alternatingSeries (5!/2 = 60)

certificate1.statement: ∀ a v : alternatingGroup (Fin 4), a ≠ 1 → a*a ≠ 1 → v*v = 1 → v*a = a*v → v = 1

_meta.reflectRule: v - (Σ j, cartan i j * v j) • e_i

lieFamilies.characteristicRule: lieOrdersChar p = lieOrdersOver (p^k) (k>=1), plus ^2B2/^2F4 over 2^(2k+1) when p=2, plus ^2G2 over 3^(2k+1) when p=3, plus Tits when p=2

mathieuCertificates.description: Exact Schreier chains, explicit Sylows and exhaustive prime-order subgroup normal-generation certificates for the five pinned Mathieu permutation groups. SymPy only searched for witnesses; the standard-library verifier checks every claimed identity and coverage condition.
mathieuCertificates.permutationConvention: zero-based images; (a*b)(i)=a(b(i)); signed words use one-based generator indices

meta.readMode: read-only text extraction; no lake build, no Lean compilation (CONTRACT rule 5)

monsterSuborbit2A.indexing: Fin 9 — the nine 2A suborbits of the Monster's 2A involution

relatorFamilies.rule: (x_i x_j) ^ 3 when i ~ j, (x_i x_j) ^ 2 otherwise

sporadicOrders.note: sporadicOrderList is a Finset ℕ: CFSG asserts the 26-element set of sporadic orders but does not index it by group name. Name attributions appear only where a separate CFSG theorem or named definition pins them.
